chapter.heading: A psalm of David.
chapter.v:
I will
sing of your faithful love and good judgment. I will sing praises to you, Lord.

I will
make sure my life is blameless. When will you come and help me? My life will be one of integrity even in private.

I will
not look at anything evil. I hate doing wrong—I won't have anything to do with it.

I won't
think bad thoughts—I won't even consider anything evil.

I will
silence anyone who secretly slanders their neighbor. I won't tolerate anyone who is proud and arrogant.

I look
for faithful people to live with me; only those who are trustworthy will serve me.

No one
who is dishonest will live in my house; no liars will be allowed in my presence.

I work
every day to silence the wicked in the land, to rid the city of the Lord of all who do evil.
